messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: routing-service error spike detected (policy-eval). 40% of requests hitting fallback path in us-west-2, causing elevated latency and incorrect model variants. Paging oncall.
maria: acked — I'm looking. seeing a config change 10m ago from the config-api deploy that touched routing.policy schema.
oncall: I'm up, jumping in. can you paste the deploy id?
maria: deploy-bot reports deploy 2026-03-15_22:10:11 by jess to config-api. changelog mentions 'schema v3' removal of deprecated fields.
aj: grabbing logs. `kubectl logs -n config config-api-8f7d -c api | tail -n 200` shows validation passed but there are warnings about unknown fields.
leo: FYI getting a lot of "no variant match, falling through" traces in routing-service logs. sample:
```
2026-03-15T22:13:02Z routing-service ERROR select_variant failed for req=abc123: no explicit variant, fallback_policy=FALLTHROUGH -> choose(default_variant)
2026-03-15T22:13:02Z routing-service WARN selected variant small-v2 for model family 'redwood-open' due to missing preferred_variant
```
samir: that "choose(default_variant)" path should have been behind the deprecated field mapping. looks like schema v3 removed the compatibility shim that mapped legacy `preferredModel` -> `preferred_variant`.
maria: right. the config change removed support for the legacy key `preferredModel` and also changed the default for `route_fallthrough` to true implicitly. result: policies that relied on the legacy key now evaluate as no-preferred-variant + fallthrough -> selected small-v2 default in us-west-2. that explains wrong model variant + latency.
jess: paging notes — which customers impacted?
aj: early telemetry: 5% error rate bump overall across hosted API for 120s window, but two enterprise tenants (acct-452, acct-907) saw 8-12% increase in generation latency and some 500s for streaming. I've DM'd CSMs.
leo: mitigation proposals: 1) flip global gating to strict-variant-match for policy evals 2) re-enable compatibility mapping in config-api (quick rollback) 3) patch routing-service to ignore fallthrough on policy eval until config stable.
oncall: prioritize quick rollback of mapping in config-api if that's a small change. can we hotfix deploy?
maria: I can roll a config-api patch with the compatibility middleware within 10-15m. it just maps `preferredModel` -> `preferred_variant` and sets explicit `route_fallthrough: false` for policies missing the new key.
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy of config-api hotfix 2026-03-15_22:31:00 to us-west-2 (canary 10%).
aj: while canary runs, I'm setting an emergency override in routing-service to stop client-level fallthrough for all enterprise tiers: `POST /admin/overrides {"fallthrough_enabled": false}` — applying now.
aj: override applied. confirmed in logs: `fallthrough disabled via emergency override by aj`.
leo: seeing drop in error rate in us-west-2 after override. latency trending down within 90s.
samir: canary looks good. no new validation warnings and policies report preferred_variant set again thanks to the compatibility layer.
jess: thumbs for quick rollback, maria & aj. :thumbsup:
maria: rolling out hotfix to remaining regions now.
deploy-bot: rollout complete 2026-03-15_22:44:55. no failures.
oncall: handing off to aj for ongoing monitoring for the next 2 hours. aj, you have the pager.
aj: taking handoff. summary: config schema v3 removed legacy key mapping. policies without new key fell into fallthrough default -> selected smaller variants and sometimes region fallback loops. immediate mitigation: emergency override to disable fallthrough + config-api compatibility hotfix rolled. impact: transient latency + errors for some customers, mitigated.
aj: follow-ups (assigning): PROD-1132 add compatibility unit tests for schema migrations, PROD-1133 make fallthrough default explicit (never implicit), PROD-1134 add alerting for unusual variant selection rate per region. I'll create tickets.
jess: customers notified: sent initial incident update to impacted CSMs and posted status on status.redwood.ai (no PII).
samir: one note: we saw a small region fallback loop where us-east attempted eu-west and back because routing policy mismatched region tag. logs show repeated route evaluation for same request id ~6 times before abort; we should add loop-detection in routing-service.
leo: agreed — add a simple per-request hop counter >=3 -> abort and metric.
aj: monitoring: set a temporary dashboard for variant-selection-by-region and a 5min alert if >3% of requests select an unexpected default variant.
oncall: thanks team — handoff complete. I'll be reachable if the override needs to be toggled back.
maria: postmortem owner: jess. ETA for draft 48h. primary causes: aggressive schema removal without compatibility shim + implicit default semantics. action items assigned.
jess: got it, I'll start the postmortem and coordinate customer comms. incident cleared from critical — moving to L2 monitoring. :white_check_mark:
